desc.aachen-chapel: Inspires units in a large radius so long as a Prelate is garrisoned. Acts as a drop-off point for all resource types.
desc.abbey-of-kings: Heals all nearby friendly units that are out of combat by +6 every 1 seconds. May also Crown a King, a powerful cavalry leader with a healing aura. Queues production of a free King upon completion.
desc.abbey-of-the-trinity: Acts as a Monastery. Reduces the cost of Warrior Monks by -50% and contains unique religious technologies.
desc.angevin-empire: Fortresses and Docks gain +30% health. (Not simulated.)
desc.astronomical-clocktower: Acts as a Siege Workshop and produces siege engines with +50% health.
desc.barbican-of-the-sun: Fires a long range hand cannon and adds arrowslits while garrisoned. Can be upgraded with weaponry and offers vision into Stealth Forests. Imperial Officials can drop off taxes at this building.
desc.berkshire-palace: Acts as a Keep with increased health and powerful incendiary arrows. All weapons have 14.5 tiles of range.
desc.burgrave-palace: Acts as a Barracks that produces 400% faster. Infantry gains +50% charge damage.
desc.capital-town-center: All Resources can be dropped off here. Produces Villagers, Scouts, and increases your maximum Population. Pilgrims start their journey to Sacred Sites here. Adds additional attacks while garrisoned. Capital Town Centers can detect units stealth or disguises.
desc.castle-of-the-crow: Acts as a Castle. Can periodically spawn Treasure Caravans from selected neutral Trading Posts to provide a large amount of Food, Wood, Gold, and some Stone when reaching the Castle of the Crow.
desc.chamber-of-commerce: Acts as a Market. Trains one free Trader for each economic technology researched.
desc.cistern-of-the-first-hill: Acts as a Cistern. Unlocks the Pilgrim Flask ability on non-siege military units, which can be activated to increase health regeneration by 25 per second for 6 seconds. Flasks refill every 30 seconds to a maximum of 20 active flasks.
desc.college-of-artillery: Produces the Royal Artillery versions of the Cannon, Ribauldequin, and Culverin, which do +30% more damage. Unlocks the Artillery ability for all Cannons. Contains Siege and Gunpowder Technologies, trains units and researches technologies 50% faster.
desc.compound-of-the-defender: Infantry units can build Stone Walls, Gates, and Towers. Reduces Stone cost of buildings and their emplacements by 20%. Contains defensive technologies that ignore building and Imperial Age (IV) requirements.
desc.council-hall: Acts as an Archery Range with all units and technologies. Works +100% faster. Longbowmen produced from this landmark are -5% cheaper.
desc.culture-wing: Age II: all technologies cost -20%. (Medical Centers and Public Libraries are not simulated.)
desc.deer-stones: Deer Stones grant access to the Khan's Hunter at the Archery Range. Instantly researches the Yam Network technology.
desc.dome-of-the-faith: Acts as a Mosque. Produce Scholars at a discount of 55 Gold.
desc.dragon-pavilion: Grants a free Meng'an Mouke Emplacement to all Town Centers and comes with a Meng'an Mouke Emplacement. Trains Emissaries at a 33% discount and spawns 1 free Emissary upon completion. Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.
desc.economic-wing: Age II: Economy buildings and Houses cost -30%. Age III: Farms gather +15% faster. Age IV: villagers drop off +8% more.
desc.elzbach-palace: Acts as a Keep with +50% health. All buildings within influence take -25% less damage. Can train 8 Black Riders per Keep instead of 5.
desc.farimba-garrison: Enlist one of three units to enhance your roster for free: the Mansa Musofadi, Mansa Javelineer, or Freeborn Warrior. The other two can be enlisted for an additional cost.
desc.floating-gate: Produces a Shinto Priest carrying a Yorishiro every 2 minutes. The first priest spawns instantly. Deposit up to 4 Yorishiro in buildings to provide unique bonuses. Unlocks Shinto Shrines, which contains unique Shinto technologies and produces Shinto Priests.
desc.flower-pagoda: Grants the ability to plant a Flower Garden which improves the gather rate of Villagers and the attack speed of non-siege military units as long as they are in the Flower Garden. Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.
desc.foreign-engineering-company: Allows production of Nest of Bees, Huihui Pao, and Royal Cannons with Olive Oil. Mercenaries receive various unique technologies from their original civilization.
desc.fort-of-the-huntress: Acts as a Keep that shoots poison arrows. Infantry units nearby the Landmark enter Stealth for 30 seconds. Musofadi Warriors and Musofadi Gunners gain First Strike, dealing more damage when breaking Stealth with an attack.
desc.fortress: Unique Landmark fortification for the Knights Templar, can be fully destroyed. Has an aura that improves nearby units range. Each Fortress increases the number of Pilgrims travelling.
desc.golden-horn-tower: Periodically produces unlocked Mercenary Units for free.
desc.golden-tent: The Golden Horde advances by building the Golden Tent. (Edicts and Fortified Outpost influence are not simulated.)
desc.grand-fulani-corral: Nearby cattle provide 18 Food per minute.
desc.grand-winery: Acts as a Mill and Monastery. Nearby Villagers gather +60% Olive Oil from Berry Bushes and Olive Groves. Relics garrisoned generate Olive Oil instead of Gold.
desc.great-pasture: Acts as a War Stable and Grassland. Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.
desc.great-wall-bastion: Acts as a Keep with 4 mounted Bed Crossbow weapons instead of regular emplacements. Increases the damage of all Bed Crossbow projectiles by +3. Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.
desc.great-wall-gatehouse: Must be built over Stone Walls. Comes with a Nest of Bees emplacement and provides +25% ranged damage to all units on walls.
desc.griot-bara: Begin a festival for 300 Gold, providing global enhancements to Food gather rates, unit production speeds, or damage of torches and siege attacks. One festival may be active at a time.
desc.guild-hall: Generates and stores resources over time, the more resources stored the faster they are generated. Select between Food, Wood, Stone, or Gold. Generates stone at half the rate.
desc.high-armory: Decrease the cost of siege engines in nearby Siege Workshops by -20%. Contains unique siege engine technologies.
desc.high-trade-house: Generates Gold like a Hunting Cabin with the value increased by +400%, without claiming any trees. Spawns a Huntable Deer every 60 seconds. Villagers can drop off Food at this building.
desc.hisar-academy: Acts as Madrasa. Generates +12 Food per minute based on the number of technologies researched. Does not apply to emplacements.
desc.house-of-learning: Grants no immediate bonus other than advancing to the next Age, but contains many unique technologies.
desc.house-of-wisdom: Contains civilization technology for the Abbasid Dynasty. Abbasids advance in Ages through the House of Wisdom. Construct wings to advance to the next Age and gain additional technology.
desc.imperial-academy: Nearby buildings generate 100% more Gold from taxes. Imperial Officials produced here cost 30% less resources and can drop off taxes at this building.
desc.imperial-hippodrome: Acts as a Stable. Contains the Triumph ability that can be activated with Supply Points to increase cavalry melee damage, move speed, and health regeneration. Comes with 10 Supply Points and generates one every 25 seconds. Earn more points by defeating enemy units.
desc.imperial-palace: A spy Landmark with 28 tile sight radius and the Imperial Spies ability. Activate to view location of enemy workers for 15 seconds. Imperial Officials can drop off taxes at this building.
desc.istanbul-imperial-palace: Doubles Imperial Council experience gained globally and increases the Vizier Point limit by +4.
desc.istanbul-observatory: Acts as a University. Improves the influence provided by the University and Blacksmith and production speed of the Grand Galley to +85%.
desc.jiangnan-tower: Acts as a tax drop-off for Imperial Officials. Military Buildings and Military Units produced within influence award progress towards free armies. Each free army requires progressively more resources to be spent than the last, until 12 armies have been produced.
desc.khaganate-palace: Automatically spawns diverse armies from across the Mongol Empire and its dominions.
desc.kingdom-of-castile: Units near Sacred Sites gain +20% damage and regenerate health. (Not simulated.)
desc.kingdom-of-france: Land military units are produced +15% faster and cost -5% gold.
desc.kingdom-of-poland: All cavalry gain +10% health. (+50% charge damage not simulated.)
desc.kings-college: Reduces research costs of all technologies by -20%. Contains unique Military technologies for House of Lancaster.
desc.kings-palace: Acts as a Town Center. Produces Villagers +10% faster.
desc.knights-hospitaller: Villagers have +30% health and +10% move speed. (Healing +30% not simulated.)
desc.koka-township: Can produce Shinobi espionage units which specialize in scouting, sabotage, and assassination. Queues production of a free Shinobi upon completion.
desc.kremlin: Acts as a Wooden Fortress that comes with Arrowslits, Castle Turret, and Castle Watch technologies. Can Levy Militia every 80 seconds to the Capital Town Center. The number of Militia levied increases upon reaching the Castle Age.
desc.kura-storehouse: Universal drop-off location that creates a Farm around the Landmark every 50 seconds — generates Wood instead when farmland becomes full.
desc.kurultai: Nearby units within its aura heal +1 health every 1 second and gain an additional +20% damage.
desc.lancaster-castle: Defensive Landmark that can do a one-time muster of units in each Age. The cost of mustering units is reduced by 50 resources per Manor. Grants all Manors +500 health and an arrowslit emplacement.
desc.mansa-quarry: Generates 75 Gold per minute. Can be toggled to generate Stone instead.
desc.meditation-gardens: Increases the resource value of nearby gold veins, stone outcroppings, and berry bushes by +5% every 30 seconds up to a maximum of +60%. Trees are increased at a lesser rate of +2.5% up to +30%. After 330 seconds, generates resources equal to 5% of the current resources in those nearby deposits. Additionally generates 5% of the maximum resources of each deposit when fully gathered.
desc.mehmed-imperial-armory: Produces siege engines for free but with a longer train time.
desc.meinwerk-palace: Acts like a Blacksmith. Technology researched here costs -50% and researches 50% faster. Contains Technologies unique to this Landmark.
desc.military-wing: Grants 2 Spearmen and 2 Archers (Age II), 2 Camel Riders (Age III) or 3 Handcannoneers (Age IV).
desc.monument-of-the-great-khan: A great monument to the Khan of the Golden Horde.
desc.mount-lu-academy: Imperial Officials collect tax twice as often and also collect 20% of taxes as Food. Contains unique upgrades that greatly improve the Imperial Official unit.
desc.mountain-hall: Acts as a Monastery and Monasteries are 50% cheaper. Generate Karma by gathering resources near Monasteries. Losing units decreases Karma. At max Karma, receive the blessing of the Four Heavenly Kings for 60 seconds. - Buildings regenerate 50 health per second. - Villagers gather from Farms +75% faster. - Relics generate +300% more gold. - Defenses attack +50% faster. Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.
desc.pagoda-forest: Spawns a Small Pagoda Forest nearby every 30 seconds up to a cap of 15. Each Small Pagoda Forest generates 20 Wood every 30 seconds and slows nearby enemy movement speed by 20%. May garrison up to 3 Monks to cast a large cascading conversion, which grows larger for every Monk garrisoned. Spawns 3 Grassland Posts. Only one Grassland may be constructed on these Grassland Posts.
desc.palace-of-swabia: Acts as a Town Center. Produces Villagers +200% faster and at -66% cost. Cost to build this Landmark is reduced by -10%.
desc.palace-of-the-sultan: Automatically produces Sultan's Elite Tower Elephants. Garrison up to 4 Scholars in the Landmark to increase production speed.
desc.palatine-school: When training Limitanei, Varangian Guards, Cataphracts, or Cheirosiphons there is a 30% chance to also spawn one at this Landmark.
desc.red-palace: Acts as a Keep. Features high-damage arbalest emplacements. Each garrisoned unit adds an additional arbalest. Activates an Arbalest emplacement on all Keeps and Town Centers.
desc.regnitz-cathedral: Acts as a Monastery. All Relics generate +100% gold while garrisoned.
desc.republic-of-venice: Market price changes are reduced by 75%. (Not simulated.)
desc.royal-institute: Houses all technologies unique to the French. Research is -30% cheaper here and ignores Age requirements.
desc.ryokan: Increases Population by +60 and nearby units get a permanent healing buff, healing 4 every 5 seconds when out of combat.
desc.saharan-trade-network: Acts as a Toll Outpost that comes with Defensive Javelin Emplacement researched. Unlocks Javelin Emplacement for Outposts. All Traders and Trade Ships taxed will generate Food equal to the taxed Gold at this Landmark. All other Toll Outposts will generate 50% of taxed Gold as Food.
desc.sake-brewery: The Brewery will create Toko-Koji Mats around itself which can be worked by Villagers to generate Gold. Villagers can drop-off Stone and Gold at this building.
desc.school-of-cavalry: Acts as a Stable. All of your stables produce units +20% faster.
desc.sea-gate-castle: Acts as a Keep with a free Great Bombard emplacement. Defensive Strucutures deal 20% more damage. All Keeps gain an aura that increases Trader and Trade Ship movement speed by +30% and armor by +8.
desc.shaolin-monastery: Unique Monastery capable of producing Shaolin Monks. From the Yuan Dynasty onwards, Shaolin Monks can also be produced from Pagodas.
desc.spasskaya-tower: Acts as a Keep with all weapon emplacements and increased health. Unlocks the building of Stone Walls, Stone Gates, and Stone Wall Towers.
desc.spirit-way: Dynasty technology can be researched here for -50% cost and +150% research speed. When a dynasty unit is killed, nearby units receive +20% attack speed and +20 health over 10 seconds. Imperial Officials can drop off taxes at this building.
desc.steppe-redoubt: Acts as a Ger. Gold dropped off at this Landmark is increased by +50%.
desc.sultanhani-trade-network: Acts as a Market. Comes with 3 Traders garrisoned and generates +26 Gold per minute for each one. Up to 10 Traders can be garrisoned.
desc.sword-hunt-statue: Daimyo cost decreased by 50% and increases Daimyo Aura attack speed bonus +20%. Level 3 Daimyo Estates will spawn levies +100% faster.
desc.tanegashima-gunsmith: Stockpiles weapon supplies every 30 seconds that can be used to instantly produce gunpowder units - comes with 2 stockpiles. Produces Ozutsu, a unique heavy ranged gunpowder infantry with siege damage. Allows access to Ribauldequins.
desc.temple-of-equality: Produces Buddhist Monks and contains unique Buddhist technologies. Buddhist Monks and Buddhist Temples provide support in combat by decreasing enemy damage with Sohei's Sutra. Buddhist monks enhance the damage of nearby units when using Buddhist Conversion. Also allows construction of 4 additional Buddhist Temples.
desc.temple-of-the-sun: Activate powerful abilities that improve speed, damage, range, or regeneration of specific units.
desc.the-golden-gate: Allows the exchange of resources at a favorable rate. Generates an additional exchange every 50 seconds.
desc.the-silver-tree: Acts as a Market. Production speed of Traders increased by +40% with a -40% reduced Gold cost.
desc.the-white-stupa: Acts as an Ovoo and produces 240 Stone per minute without a Stone Outcropping. Decreases the Stone cost of double unit production by -50%.
desc.the-white-tower: Acts as a Keep with all the behaviors, technologies, and bonuses. Works 75% faster.
desc.tower-of-victory: Enables Tower of Victory, Mosques, and Madrasas to increase the attack speed of infantry by +20% when produced within their influence.
desc.trade-wing: Acts as a home Market. (Free Traders are not simulated.)
desc.twin-minaret-medrese: Acts as a Mill. Grows 4 Berry Bushes which can be harvested +50% faster. Berry Bushes are regrown after 120 seconds if depleted.
desc.wynguard-palace: Allows production of 4 battalions: Wynguard Army, Wynguard Rangers, Wynguard Raiders, and Wynguard Footmen.
desc.zhu-xis-library: Hosts a range of highly unique upgrades. Can unlock Yuan Raiders and Imperial Guards. Only 2 technologies can be researched.
